name: harden
description: Standalone mutation-hardening stage. Checks out an existing pipeline branch, mutation-tests only the source changed since the merge-base, and scores the result. Below the gate it runs up to max_rounds strengthen rounds: a Sonnet agent writes tests (test files only) aimed at the surviving mutants, every round crosses the tests-only tamper gate with a GPT judge, equivalent-mutant claims go to a GPT judge, and only the remaining survivors are rescored. Records result, score, gate_passed and the survivors file (the refine stage's focus seed) in the pipeline manifest; a miss or a skip is still done.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Existing remote branch to check out and harden.

inputs.name: base_branch
inputs.description: Recorded as the manifest's top-level base_branch when this stage's finish creates the manifest. Empty leaves it unset.

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Teams webhook URL, accepted for parity with the other stages. Leave empty in the committed sample.

inputs.name: base_ref
inputs.description: Diff base for mutation scoping. Empty falls back to the manifest base_branch.

inputs.name: baseline_path
inputs.description: Committed test baseline (relative to ./work) whose suite commands are used. Empty falls back to implement's baseline_path, else the registry default command.

inputs.name: gate_threshold
inputs.description: Mutation score (percent) that passes the gate.

inputs.name: max_rounds
inputs.description: Strengthen round cap. A miss after it is recorded, not failed.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone repo_url and add a worktree at ./work on the existing remote branch.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift work_dir and run_date to top-level vars.

nodes.label: Resolve inputs
nodes.description: An explicit base_ref or baseline_path wins; otherwise baseline_path comes from implement's manifest entry. scope falls back to the manifest base_branch (resolve-inputs.outputs.base_branch) when base_ref is empty.

nodes.label: Resolve diff scope
nodes.description: Base is resolve-inputs.inputs.base_ref, else the manifest base_branch; neither, or no merge-base, fails the stage. Fetches at depth 200 (unshallowing if needed) and emits {base_ref, merge_base}. Halts: retrying cannot supply a missing base.

nodes.label: Classify changed files
nodes.description: Roles (source, test, config, ci) and source files by language for merge-base..HEAD. detect mutates only changed source.

nodes.label: Detect mutation tools
nodes.description: Per language with changed source: no registered tool -> skipped; a probe failure -> exit 1 listing every install_hint (a missing tool fails the stage); else runnable. The test command comes from the baseline (R6), else the registry default. Halts: a missing tool will not appear on retry. Repository code (version probes, mutation tools, tests) runs only inside scripts/sandbox.sh: scrubbed environment, restricted filesystem, no network, and no unisolated fallback (exit 1 'no isolation available').

nodes.label: Anything to mutate?
nodes.description: No runnable language (no changed source, or no registered tool) skips to report, which records result skipped, score null and gate passed: the stage is done, not failed.

nodes.label: Mutation run
nodes.description: Dispatches scripts/mutate-<lang>.sh per runnable language, diff-scoped, and normalizes the results into {{workspace}}/harden/state.json. Leaves the worktree clean. Halts without retry: adapter failures (a missing tool, report drift) are deterministic, and a retry would rerun an hour-long run to the same failure. Repository code (version probes, mutation tools, tests) runs only inside scripts/sandbox.sh: scrubbed environment, restricted filesystem, no network, and no unisolated fallback (exit 1 'no isolation available').

nodes.label: Score (initial)
nodes.description: Scores state.json against gate_threshold and writes {{workspace}}/harden/survivors-round.json for strengthen.

nodes.label: Gate passed?
nodes.description: First-match. A passing score goes to report. So does an unscorable run: with the gate already failed, denominator 0 means every mutant was excluded (score null, reason "all N mutants excluded ..."), a broken mutation build that leaves strengthen no survivor to target; report records the gate failure. Otherwise the strengthen rounds.

nodes.label: Mark round start
nodes.description: Loop head. Records HEAD (the tamper gate's base) and a fresh pass_id for this round.

nodes.label: Snapshot score state
nodes.description: Hashes harden/state.json and survivors-round.json (the hashes stay in this node's output, out of the agent's reach) and copies them aside before strengthen runs with Write access to the workspace.

nodes.label: Strengthen tests
nodes.description: Fixes any must-fix items from a voided round first, then writes tests (test files only) to kill the survivors in survivors-round.json. May claim equivalent mutants in {{workspace}}/harden/equivalence-claims.json. Commits only and leaves the tree clean. Claude doer, so both judges are GPT.

nodes.label: Worktree clean?
nodes.description: The mutation adapters refuse a dirty tree, so uncommitted changes left by strengthen would fail the stage at rescore. Reports them and, with --discard, restores the tree to HEAD (reset --hard, clean -fd, never -x); commits are untouched.

nodes.label: Score state untouched?
nodes.description: Verifies the score state against state-snapshot's hashes. An edit by strengthen (a mutant set to killed, an extended approved_equivalents) is restored from the copy and the round is voided; a copy that was altered too exits 1.

nodes.label: Round left a dirty tree or edited state?
nodes.description: First-match. A round that left uncommitted changes, or whose agent edited the score state, is voided as a whole (it still counts), so the stage still ends done. A clean round goes to the tamper gate.

nodes.label: Tamper gate (tests only)
nodes.description: Deterministic check of the round for weakened tests. --tests-only makes any source change a forced void (source_changed), as does a history rewrite.

nodes.label: Void, judge or pass?
nodes.description: First-match, so the deterministic void comes first: a source edit or a history rewrite voids the round even when judgeable findings also exist. Judgeable findings go to the cross-family judge; a clean round is pushed, then goes to the claims.

nodes.label: Void round (dirty tree)
nodes.description: Forced void for a round that left uncommitted changes: resets to the round base, clears the equivalence scratch (R8) and writes must-fix.md naming the reason. --force-void is required: this runs before the tamper gate; clean-check has removed the previous round's findings.json, so must-fix.md carries no stale findings.

nodes.label: Void round (score state edited)
nodes.description: Forced void for a round whose strengthen agent edited the score state (state-check has already restored it): resets to the round base, clears the equivalence scratch and writes must-fix.md naming the reason.

nodes.label: Void round (forced)
nodes.description: Void for a round the tests-only gate forced (a source change or a history rewrite): resets the worktree to the round base, clears the round's equivalence claims and verdicts (R8) and writes {{workspace}}/tamper/must-fix.md. No --force-void, so tamper-verdict reads this round's fresh findings.json and names the real reason (source_changed or history_rewritten). The round still counts.

operations.value: harden round {{harden_round}}: tests written to kill surviving mutants listed in {{workspace}}/harden/survivors-round.json; only test files may change

nodes.label: Judge context
nodes.description: Tells the judge what the round was supposed to do.

nodes.label: Tamper judge
nodes.description: GPT-family judge for the Claude doer (strengthen on coder-sonnet5-high). Rules on every finding id and writes only {{workspace}}/tamper/verdict.json.

nodes.label: Apply tamper verdict
nodes.description: Fails closed: a missing or malformed verdict, an unruled finding or any legitimate:false voids the round, resets to the round base, clears the equivalence scratch (R8) and writes must-fix.md. A round that stands is left as is.

nodes.label: Round voided?
nodes.description: Entered only straight after tamper-verdict, so the verdict is this round's. A voided round skips the push, the claims and the rescore.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: push round
nodes.description: Pushes a round that stood, once the tamper gate has ruled, so a stopped run keeps the tests it added. Voids reset to the round base, which is already pushed, so they skip this.

nodes.label: Count equivalence claims
nodes.description: Counts claims in {{workspace}}/harden/equivalence-claims.json; a missing or malformed file counts as 0.

nodes.label: Any claims?
nodes.description: Claims go to the cross-family judge; otherwise straight to the rescore.

nodes.label: Judge equivalence claims
nodes.description: GPT-family judge for the Claude doer. Rules on each claim and writes {{workspace}}/harden/equivalence-verdicts.json; the file is what is read (agent_call does not enforce outputSchema).

nodes.label: Record equivalents
nodes.description: Merges equivalent:true rulings into state.json; an unruled claim is rejected. Removes the claims and verdicts files.

nodes.label: Rescore survivors
nodes.description: Re-runs mutation only on files that still have survivors and REPLACES the whole earlier result set of every file it re-runs with the fresh one (fresh evidence is authoritative; nothing is inherited through a reused line key). Files not re-run keep their results; an equivalent-mutant approval in a re-run file survives only if its key is still reported and the file is unchanged. Records round harden_round + 1. Halts without retry: adapter failures (a missing tool, report drift) are deterministic, and a retry would rerun an hour-long run to the same failure. Repository code (version probes, mutation tools, tests) runs only inside scripts/sandbox.sh: scrubbed environment, restricted filesystem, no network, and no unisolated fallback (exit 1 'no isolation available').

nodes.label: Score (round)
nodes.description: Rescores state.json and rewrites survivors-round.json for the next round.

nodes.label: harden_round++
nodes.description: Counts rounds, voided ones included, for the max_rounds cap.

nodes.label: Round loop or exit
nodes.description: First-match. A passing score exits. An unscorable rescore (gate failed, every mutant excluded) exits too: there is nothing left to target. Then the round cap: a miss after max_rounds goes to report with gate_passed false, which is not a stage failure. A voided round leaves score-r absent or stale, never passed (the loop would already have exited). Otherwise the next round.

nodes.label: Write harden report
nodes.description: Writes and commits .arbitron/pipeline/<slug>.harden.json and <slug>.survivors.json together, and emits the stage outputs. focus_seed_path is the survivors file when the gate failed, else empty.

args: {result: .report.result, skip_reason: .report.skip_reason, score: .report.score, gate_passed: .report.gate_passed, survivors_path: .report.survivors_path, focus_seed_path: .report.focus_seed_path, harden_report_path: .report.harden_report_path}

nodes.label: Record stage
nodes.description: Pushes the branch and records the harden entry in .arbitron/pipeline/<slug>.json. A miss or a skip is still done. Its outputs are the stage contract.
